task: Port the narwhal-portal CI/CD (11 workflows, dependabot) into narwhal's root .github after the monorepo import, and delete the inert portal/.github

events.summary: Only .github (portal-*.yml workflows, dependabot npm /portal entry, lint.yml sibling-checkout removal), two portal/scripts that read .github, portal/SECURITY.md example/tag text, root .gitignore negations and two regression-check-kakao.sh hunks (R112 egress-allowlist, R210 portal CHANGELOG exclusion) change. portal/.github is deleted. No portal application source, no cluster, no branch-protection API call.

Path-filter trap documented: portal main requires the check 'Portal critical regression gate'. A workflow-level paths: filter (or a portal/-only trigger) leaves a required check Pending forever on PRs that do not touch portal/, so narwhal-only PRs could never merge. Reproduced by design: portal-test.yml's old triggers (pull_request, no filter) would run the 619+ test suites on every narwhal PR, while path-filtering it would hang the required context. Also reproduced two latent breakages from moving the files: check-lockfile-cooling.mjs did 'git show base:pnpm-lock.yaml' (repo-root path, empty base inside portal/), and check-supply-chain-policy.mjs readdirSync('.github/workflows') threw once portal/.github was gone.

portal-test.yml: always-triggered 'changes' job (git diff --name-only base...head, fail-open on unknown base, fail-closed if the job itself fails) gates the heavy jobs; 'Portal gate' (always()) accepts skipped only when changes succeeded and reported portal=false, else requires success. Tag namespace portal/v*.*.* (v* never matches portal/v1.2.3: '*' does not cross '/'), IMAGE hardcoded ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal, tag prefix stripped via metadata-action semver value=, context portal. Fixed git show ...:./pnpm-lock.yaml and the policy script's workflow dir. Dry-run of the extracted change-filter step: portal-touching range -> portal=true, narwhal-only range -> portal=false, zero base and workflow_dispatch -> true.

events.scope: R245 and immutable-input guards over the new workflows
events.summary: check-install-scripts.py passes with an empty baseline over the ported workflows (all pnpm installs carry --ignore-scripts).
